root_idea.summary: The root centers on a settled place or locus of residence, especially a human dwelling or home.
root_idea.development: The place-of-residence notion extends to taking land as a homeland and settling in a country; derived uses also describe preparing oneself for, or submitting oneself to, an undertaking.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic plural is presented under the normalized singular citation form مَوْطِن.

senses.definition: A place of settlement or residence; in the Quranic plural, a locality or region.
senses.usage_conditions: Attested in the Quran only as the plural مَوَاطِنَ. The supplied occurrence is contextually rendered “regions”; this is treated as the place or locality sense rather than as a separate meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A settled place of abode or residence; a dwelling or home.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural أَوْطَان is also used for the resting places of sheep.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a land one's homeland; to take it as a settled place of residence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Explicitly attested in the construction involving taking the land as a homeland.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare, discipline, or persuade oneself to undertake a thing; to make oneself disposed to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the self or mind in constructions expressing preparation or inducement to an undertaking, including constructions with عَلَى or لِـ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To undertake a thing and submit oneself to it; to become disposed to do it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive construction describing the mind or person becoming prepared and subjecting itself to an undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a country or place as one's home; to settle there.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may express adopting a country as a home or settling in a settled place of abode.
A distinct derivative listed in the root's Classical lexical material.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form II self-disposition and preparation meaning represented.
Inducing or persuading oneself to undertake the thing is included in the Form II entry.
Pointer-only unit referring to Form X.
Form V undertaking, submission, and self-disposition meaning represented.
Form X taking a country as home or settling meaning represented.
The place-of-abode meaning is represented for the Quranic locality sense and the distinct Classical noun وَطَن.

cautions: The sole Quran occurrence is the plural مَوَاطِنَ; مَوْطِن is used as the normalized dictionary citation form.
The Form IV Lane unit is pointer-only; its independent meaning is retained from the explicit Classical expression أَوْطَنَتِ الأرضَ rather than inferred from the pointer alone.
The contextual rendering “regions” does not create an additional Quranic sense beyond the lexical place or locality meaning.
